reuse_assessment.A_C_natural_r025_and_r1: Both complete under identical historical exactrestore/R0-replay core; historical baselines can be cited as comparison controls when new three-probe implementation preserves lifecycle, data, RNG final advance, eval, matching and all config factors. Deleting unused probes requires a meaningful equivalence check before calling the new implementation numerically identical.
reuse_assessment.A_C_matched_r025_and_r1: Both complete; only needed if matched g0+B experiments are in scope.
reuse_assessment.A_P_natural_r025_and_r1: Both complete; closest path-matched unprojected residual control to isolate g0+B vs A_C path change.
reuse_assessment.g0_g1_plus_g1_minus_and_g0_matched: Completed radius-independent controls stored under r=.25; do not relabel their outer probe diagnostics as r1.
reuse_assessment.caveat: Historical 4-probe allocation and new 3-probe allocation differ in number of backward calls, even if unused passes are removed without state/RNG effects. Hardware nondeterminism means trajectories need not be bitwise equal across separate full trainings.

metric_definitions.AAA_task_macro: mean over 10 stages of mean over seen task accuracy
